description.value: Papa John's is a pizza fast-food restaurant, part of the national franchise. It is notable to touring cyclists for its brand familiarity and quick-service model. The Kingsway location provides accessible meal service without requiring reservation or seated time.

The location page fetch returned a 404 error, preventing verification of other amenities or current status. However, Papa John's is a known operating franchise, OSM marks it as not closed (looks_closed=false), and there is no evidence this is a phantom listing or permanently closed, so it qualifies for inclusion as a legitimate food option for cycling tourists.
